name: The Title Halo 1
shortDescription: Ready-to-move condominium 350 m from Naiyang Beach, 5 minutes from the airport.
description:
Six seven-floor buildings with 329 units, 350 m from Naiyang Beach (Sirinat National Park) and about 5 minutes from Phuket International Airport. Ready to move.
Units are 1-bedroom (36-51 sqm) and 2-bedroom (59-64 sqm).
priceNote: Lowest advertised price listed by an agent, source page updated 2026-07-20. Unit prices on the source are rounded to the nearest 0.1M.
furniture: Per FazWaz unit listings: fully furnished
